messages:
tina (sales): Starting HorizonCare POC perf validation. They want multi-AZ sustain of 400 qps for generate endpoint (50% chat gen / 50% embeddings), p95 < 250ms, and confirmation of multi-AZ failover behavior. Can eng ops confirm plan?
leo (eng-sre): Plan: 15m ramp, 45m steady, open-loop. We'll split traffic 60/40 across us-east-1 and us-west-2 via the smart-router. Simulate AZ flaps mid-soak to validate routing.
jules (eng-ml): Model for primary pool: redwood-1.7b-int8-opt. Fallback variant: redwood-1.7b-int8-small (fewer layers fused). Embedding model: redwood-embed-768.
maya (solutions): Add requirement: HorizonCare cares about request ordering and session sticky behavior for chat. Will we preserve session affinity on failover?
leo (eng-sre): Session affinity is preserved at request level via KV cache replication within regional pools; cross-region failover will rebuild cache so expect higher tail during warmup. We'll quantify.
deploy-bot: test_run=hc-1859876543 | start=2025-10-12T18:04:03Z | profile=45m-soak-15m-ramp | qps_target=400 | az_split=60/40
leo (eng-sre): Load command (local):
```
loadrunner --endpoint https://api.redwood.test/v1/chat --open-loop \
  --ramp 15m --duration 45m --qps 400 --mix "gen:0.5,embed:0.5" \
  --concurrency 3000 --payload ./hc_payload.json
```
jules (eng-ml): We'll warm the KV cache before steady start with a short prefix-populate job. That should cut cold-start median by ~25%.
tina (sales): Good. Capture token consumption and a back-of-envelope cost for the HorizonCare execs. Also they asked for a short SLA-friendly blurb on failover.
leo (eng-sre): Snapshot +10m: p50=42ms p95=210ms p99=620ms errs=0.4% (mostly transient 429s during ramp). Region split OK. GPU util avg 78% across primary. Cache hit ~58%.
jules (eng-ml): Embedding latency stable: p95 embed=92ms. Gen p95=210ms. Combined mix meets their p95 target so far.
leo (eng-sre): Cost estimate for whole run (45m steady ~0.95 GPU-hours + ramp) -> infra cost est $22. Ballpark token cost for them depends on mix; will include per-100k-token table.
maya (solutions): Ready to run cross-AZ flap at +30m. We'll remove 40% capacity in us-east-1 for 90s to simulate AZ loss. Notifying HorizonCare contact (cc @horizoninfra).
tina (sales): noted. Also remind that logs/graphs sharing requires NDA — they'll sign shortly.
deploy-bot: action=simulate-az-flap | target_pool=primary-east | removed=40% | timestamp=2025-10-12T18:34:20Z
leo (eng-sre): Flap induced. Observed immediate reroute to us-west-2 and fallback small-model instances. p95 jumped to 310ms for ~75s, p99 peaked at 1.4s. Error rate stayed <0.6%. Session affinity: 94% preserved, session rebuild for remaining 6% caused slightly longer tails.
jules (eng-ml): Cache miss rate spiked to 18% during the flap window; KV resync completed within ~60s. After 2m metrics returned near baseline.
tina (sales): Can we phrase that as: "Availability maintained; transient tail increase during cross-region failover; recommend scheduled critical windows with pre-warmed standby"?
maya (solutions): Yes. Recommend a policy: pre-warm standby in secondary AZ and maintain 1.5x burst headroom for critical windows. Also suggest canary routing threshold to avoid large-scale simultaneous failovers.
leo (eng-sre): Post-run final: overall p50=40ms p95=225ms p99=760ms total errors 0.35%. Total tokens ~9.6M. Attached artifacts include graphs and session-affinity trace.
tina (sales): Perfect. I'll draft the one-pager: executive summary, test matrix, graphs, cost table, and recommendations (pre-warm, burst capacity, canary thresholds). Will attach sanitized graphs until NDA is in place.
deploy-bot: run_complete | end=2025-10-12T18:17:00Z | artifacts=/runs/hc-1859876543/{graphs_sanitized,session_traces,raw_metrics} (access: internal + NDA)
leo (eng-sre): Quick add: we logged one client-side timeout spike correlated with network flakiness during ramp; not infra. Will include in notes.
maya (solutions): I'll include suggested SLA wording: "Redwood will maintain 99.9% availability with automatic routing and fallback; cross-region failover may temporarily increase tail latency; recommended pre-warm policy reduces this impact."
tina (sales): Great work. I'll send the one-pager to HorizonCare and schedule a 45m technical walkthrough with their infra + security. End thread.
